title: sort block props
description: « Classer »: items the learner places, by choosing an item then where it goes (a mouse may also drag): each with its match (pairs), into two to four categories (categories), or in order (order). Scored by the share of its items placed right; correct when all are. After the last try each item shows whether it was right, and where it belonged.
x-ai-instructions: Use it to tell cases apart (categories: sort examples, and near misses, under the concepts they illustrate), to link two sets (pairs: a term and its definition, a symptom and its cause) or to order a procedure or a timeline (order). Four to eight items: fewer is a guess, more is a chore on a phone. pairs: as many targets as items, each target holding one; the last pair is then given by elimination, so prefer categories when there are more than five pairs. categories: two to four targets, each with at least one item, items written as cases from the learner's work rather than definitions. order: write the items in the right order, the player shows them shuffled; no targets. Keep items short (a few words, or an image with its alt). Always write feedback.incorrect that explains the rule that sorts them, and feedback.correct that says why.

presentation.description: pairs: each item goes to its own target, each target takes one item. categories: two to four targets, each taking several items. order: no targets, the items are put in order (written in the right order, shown shuffled).

stem.description: The instruction (Associez chaque symptôme à sa cause.).

items.description: What the learner places, in the right order for order (they are shown in a fixed shuffled order).

alt.description: What the image shows. Required with image.

target.description: pairs and categories: the id of the target the item belongs to.

targets.description: pairs and categories: where items go (two to four categories; as many targets as items for pairs).

alt.description: What the image shows. Required with image.

scored.description: Counts in the course score (the share of its items placed right).

attempts.description: Tries before the placements are final.

showCorrectAnswer.description: After the last try, each item placed wrong says where it belonged.
